result.summary: The intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and warning signage. While the street is residential, the absence of designated crossing areas and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the main roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all four corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs to alert motorists to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal infrastructure and significant obstructions. While the narrow one-way street may naturally slow traffic, the absence of marked crossings and a sidewalk blocked by debris forces pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags and cardboard completely block the narrow sidewalk area, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground near the street sign

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the intersection, making crossing difficult for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The building on the corner is built right up to the property line, creating a blind corner for vehicles turning or pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the corner building

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Clear the debris and repair the sidewalk surface to provide a continuous, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and compliant curb ramps to facilitate safe and accessible street crossings.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Use paint or bollards to prevent parking near the corner, improving sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a sidewalk that is partially overgrown with weeds along the curb. There are no marked crosswalks or traffic control devices visible, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Overgrowth
hazards.description: Grass and weeds are encroaching on the sidewalk from the curb, narrowing the usable path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground along the curb line

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: The parked SUV blocks the view between the sidewalk and the roadway for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear overgrown vegetation and repair cracks to ensure a clear, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment is a residential street with basic sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure at the intersection.
